profiles.label: Sweeper-Keeper Receiver
profiles.description: Receives and secures loose balls and back-passes very frequently.

profiles.label: High-Volume Shot Stopper
profiles.description: Faces a heavy shot workload, usually behind a defence that concedes chances.

profiles.label: Low-Involvement Keeper
profiles.description: Below-average involvement across most dimensions, typically behind a controlling side.

profiles.label: Box Commander
profiles.description: Attacks crosses and set pieces at an unusually high rate.

diagnostics.note: k-means on standardised per-96 involvement rates. k chosen by the highest silhouette score among the configured candidates, ties broken toward fewer clusters. Labels are assigned from centroid values and only claim a style when that dimension is at least 0.5 standard deviations above the league mean.
